def: to dissipate, i.e. (genitive case) to rout or separate; specially, to winnow; figuratively, to squander

occurrences.text: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
